Same quantity setup failure, with additional passing migration assertions.
New identity assertion accidentally inserted into a separate fixture with different IDs; removed only misplaced duplicate. Final debug/release60 each pass.

Generation37 passed; restore13 functional checks passed with one last-listing visibility failure. Selection now scrolls after layout; harness opens the actual Trade tab before checking, and later restore14 passes.
Export correctly refused stale dependency graph. Shipping graph rebuilt with new resources and tracked generation hook; subsequent gates/smoke pass.

limits: Existing empty chests within224m of published town centres receive one supplies pass; nonempty contents preserved. Original chest identity upper bound includes paged-out records. Up to4096 visited markers, four records per frame, idle processing disabled. Later player placements and emptied marked chests do not receive refill.

For old worlds, an already empty chest can receive this single requested upgrade. This is not periodic respawn. New generation stocks previously unseeded unlocked chests while preserving richer locked/authored stock.

The two shop lists contain the fixed goods this trader buys/sells. Quantity controls each drag; dropping commits one native atomic exchange, cancelled/stale/unaffordable drops cannot grant free goods.
Prototype salvage values/geometry are gameplay defaults, not user-approved economy or visual acceptance.
Unqualified parking hook/files excluded from export and preserved byte-for-byte. Startup graph reflects the tracked shipping hook, while the working checkout retains that separate unfinished edit.
